_about: Left gun key battery of ga ingame (spec for branch akimbotoggle): ga.sh ingame <gun> --partner <gun> --spec tools/ingame/specs/toggle.json. Same setup as battery.json. Needs Mod Settings 'Left gun key' on (default), key F2 (keyboard default), Independent firing on (LMB left, RMB right) as in battery.json. Ops as battery.json plus key {name, wait, report}: presses the key, report adds the gs and mags lines. Expected results are in _expect (the runner ignores it). Run once per pair: SMG pair, shotgun pair, rifle pair (Gorilla Arms), Kenshin + Yukimura (no Arms), Shingen + Pulsar (top magazine), a Smart pair. Rows the harness cannot do (controller, grenade, vehicle, carry, save load) are in _manual.

_expect.T0: gs dual=true, both guns lowered (safe zone) or ready
_expect.T1: gs left=none right=<R> dual=false; right gun still drawn and held one-handed; left hand empty
_expect.T2: gs left=<L> dual=true; no swing or pistol pose on the right arm (lowered)
_expect.T3: left away; mags left=none; right gun in the one-handed pose
_expect.T4: one gun drawn: LMB fires it, RMB aims (independent firing needs two guns); shots counted for the right gun only; no script errors
_expect.T5: after holster and D1 draw: gs left=none dual=false (memory kept across the redraw)
_expect.T6: gs left=<L> dual=true; mags left = the count read at T3_mags_before (the left gun was not fired while away)
_expect.T7: the key pressed 0.4 s into a reload is refused (gs unchanged, dual=true); both reloads finish
_expect.T8: after an empty-magazine reload both guns are in the state before the key; toggling after a reload works

_manual: controller: LB + Select toggles; Select alone still opens the inventory, LB alone still scans/aims, no inventory or scanner opens from the chord; hint shows the chord icon
Key Bindings: entry 'Put away / draw left gun' (Unified Keybinds) keyboard F2, controller LB + Select; rebind to another key and back, unbind: unbound key never toggles, hint disappears
Mod Settings: 'Left gun key' category last, off: key does nothing, hint gone; a pair put away comes back at the next draw
hint: 'Put away left gun' while a pair is drawn, 'Draw left gun' while away, hidden with the other ranged hints (inventory, sprint)

grenade, pair drawn: unchanged (left away for the throw, back after). Grenade with the left gun away: observe what the right gun does (the game's own single two-handed gun logic runs, none of GorillaAkimboGadget) and that the left hand stays empty after
carry a body with the left gun away: unchanged one-handed right gun; put the body down: left gun still away
vehicle (branch vehicle): key refused in a car and on a bike; enter and leave with the left gun away: it stays away; with a pair: back on leaving as before
switch weapons with the wheel to another pair and back: the other pair is akimbo, the first stays single until the key; equip another gun into the left slot in the inventory: pair drawn
save and load with the left gun away: observe whether the right gun loads alone or the pair; the key must work either way
Smart pair: Smart Link on the left gun after the key brings it back, right gun alone has its own link
Shingen + Pulsar: key during a top-magazine reload and with a queued reload is refused; after it, the toggle and the next reloads play their clips
Gorilla Arms removed while the left gun is away: nothing breaks, the slot is cleared as before
Body scaling: the right gun alone has the scaled recoil and reload (one-handed), the same as while carrying
